context_requirements: Functional SCN5A voltage-gated sodium channel expression
Electrically excitable cell background for channel-mediated effects
Sustained channel blockade sufficient to alter membrane potential or intracellular sodium
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple antitussive drugs in these lines
Enrichment of SCN5A-dependent or sodium-channel-related gene sets after treatment
